stories.title: Berlin: Wolfram Weimer stellt Kulturförderung bei Linke-Regierungsbeteiligung infrage

en.title: Berlin: Wolfram Weimer questions cultural funding if Left party joins government
en.summary: Germany's cultural state minister has expressed opposition to the Left party entering Berlin's government, citing what he describes as antisemitism within the party. He has indirectly threatened to cut cultural funding.

stories.title: Bundeswehr: «Red Storm Charlie» – Bundeswehrübung in Hamburg gestartet

en.title: Bundeswehr: "Red Storm Charlie" - Bundeswehr exercise started in Hamburg
en.summary: The German armed forces have begun a military exercise called Red Storm Charlie in Hamburg.

stories.title: Debatte um Antisemitismus: Wolfram Weimer stellt Kulturfinanzierung für Berlin infrage

en.title: Debate on antisemitism: Wolfram Weimer questions cultural funding for Berlin
en.summary: Following the Left party's election victory, state minister Weimer has made nearly three billion euros in federal cultural funding for Berlin conditional on specific requirements.

stories.title: Deutschland-Liveblog: 150 Berliner Juden nehmen Linke in offenem Brief in Schutz

en.title: Germany liveblog: 150 Berlin Jews defend Left party in open letter
en.summary: The liveblog covers ongoing debate regarding antisemitic tendencies within the Left party, the CDU's rejection of an SPD invitation in Sachsen-Anhalt, and CSU proposals on early retirement benefits.

stories.title: Polen: Feuer in Starlink-Station – Regierung spricht von »Sabotage«

en.title: Poland: Fire at Starlink Station – Government Speaks of "Sabotage"
en.summary: A fire at a Polish Starlink station disrupted internet access for Ukrainian military forces. The digital minister attributes the incident to an attack under Russia's new offensive doctrine.

stories.title: Berlin: Dietmar Woidke warnt SPD vor Koalition mit Linken

en.title: Berlin: Dietmar Woidke warns SPD against coalition with The Left
en.summary: Despite previously leading a red-red government in Brandenburg, the state's minister president has advised Berlin's SPD against forming a coalition with The Left party, citing concerns about its current condition.

stories.title: Uli Hoeneß: Warum seine zwei Winterlinden vorerst stehen bleiben dürfen

en.title: Uli Hoeneß: Why his two linden trees are allowed to remain for now
en.summary: A dispute between Uli Hoeneß and a neighbor over two trees on his property has resulted in a court ruling in favor of the Bayern patron. The neighbor had sought to have the trees removed.

stories.title: Nachbarschaftsstreit: Eilentscheidung des Gerichts: Uli Hoeneß‘ Bäume dürfen stehen bleiben

en.title: Neighborhood dispute: Court emergency ruling: Uli Hoeneß' trees allowed to remain
en.summary: A court rejected a neighbor's demand to remove two newly planted linden trees belonging to Bayern Munich's honorary president, suggesting underlying relationship issues between the neighbors.

stories.title: Newsblog zu den Landtagswahlen: 150 jüdische Berlinerinnen und Berliner nehmen Linke in Schutz

en.title: News blog on state elections: 150 Jewish Berliners defend Left party
en.summary: Approximately 150 Jewish residents of Berlin, including notable authors, issued an open letter rejecting accusations of antisemitism against the Left party as a politically motivated tool to suppress dissent.

stories.title: Nach Wahl in Berlin: Özdemir warnt Grüne vor Koalition mit Linkspartei

en.title: After Berlin election: Özdemir warns Greens against coalition with Left party
en.summary: Following the Left party's electoral victory in Berlin, leading Green politicians have cautioned against forming a coalition, while 150 Jewish residents defend the party against antisemitism allegations.

stories.title: Poland says Starlink station fire 'act of sabotage'

en.title: Poland says Starlink station fire 'act of sabotage'
en.summary: Polish officials attributed a fire at a Starlink station to sabotage, stating the attack was intended to disrupt internet connectivity for Ukrainian military operations as part of hybrid warfare tactics.

stories.title: Wall Street: Zinssorgen bremsen US-Börsen zum Handelsstart

en.title: Wall Street: Interest rate concerns slow US markets at trading start
en.summary: Inflation risks, oil price uncertainty, and US government finances are weighing on Wall Street. Investors are monitoring the upcoming Trump-Xi meeting.

stories.title: Dax aktuell: Dax schließt im Minus – Chip-Aktie setzt Negativtrend fort

en.title: DAX today: DAX closes lower – chip stock continues negative trend
en.summary: High oil prices, rising bond yields, and geopolitical uncertainty restrained markets on Thursday. A strong Ifo business climate index failed to convince investors.

stories.title: Analyse: Geschäftsmodell unter Druck: Deutsche Konzerne bauen die meisten Stellen ab

en.title: Analysis: Business model under pressure: German corporations cut the most jobs
en.summary: DAX corporations reduced headcount by 47,700 in one year. Large European neighboring countries are performing better, though some positive developments exist in Germany.

stories.title: Märkte Insight: Gute Nachricht für Anleger: Die Nvidia-Aktie ist so billig wie seit mehr als zehn Jahren nicht mehr

en.title: Markets Insight: Good news for investors: Nvidia stock is as cheap as it has been in over ten years
en.summary: The decline in valuation of the US chip company reflects investor skepticism. Two arguments support a positive outlook for Nvidia stock according to analysis.

stories.title: Staatsbesuch: Trump betont bei Treffen mit Xi gemeinsame Freundschaft

en.title: State visit: Trump emphasizes shared friendship at meeting with Xi
en.summary: US President Trump and Chinese leader Xi met to discuss major political issues including artificial intelligence, alongside symbolic diplomatic gestures.
